page.overview:
What is Skirmish on the Alien Construct?

The Skirmish on the Alien Construct was a battle fought between the crew of the CR90 corvette FarStar, and Imperial forces allied to Moff Kentor Sarne and led by the bounty hunter Mist aboard an alien construct in the Kathol sector of the Outer Rim Territories in 8 ABY.
